thread:
Sam: Appreciate the great turnout for the runtime all-hands. Posting the compact follow-up thread for owners and quick clarifications.

Aisha: I'll summarize key asks we committed to and call owners inline: kernel-v5 canary plan, batching defaults, kv-cache TTLs, rollback thresholds, and docs + SDK flags.

Ben: Kernel-v5 canary plan: staged ramp tomorrow. Traffic slices: 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% over ~48h if signals look good. Primary signals: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token throughput, and eval-harness quality delta. Owner: Ben + Eng-ML.

Priya: Infra update: placement + scheduler changes for v5 landed in staging. No planned infra windows during rollout. We'll enable reservation windows for Dedicated customers who opt-in. I'll post reservation sheet. Owner: Priya.

Liam: Monitoring: provisional alerts set. Current thresholds: p95 > baseline * 1.2 for 10m OR error-rate >0.5% for 5m. Dashboard added with v4/v5 split. Question for Sam: are these too noisy?

Sam: Start conservative, fine for now. Make alerts editable and include a runbook link. Add a low-severity annotation for transient blips to reduce noisy pages.

Marta: KV-cache TTL defaults proposal: interactive chat default 5m, long-session conversational 30m, embeddings/indexing 24h. Expose per-route overrides in runtime config. Owner: Nadia (docs) + Aisha (runtime flags).

Nadia: I'll draft the docs + migration checklist showing how to move from unlimited-KV to TTL-backed caches. ETA: Friday EOD for draft PR.

Ben: Batching recommendations for public docs: max_batch_size=48, max_latency_ms=20, batch_window_ms=5. We'll add a Dedicated profile: max_batch_size=128, max_latency_ms=30.

Priya: Note: recommended profiles will include GPU-family tuning (A100 vs H100) for Dedicated onboarding.

Liam: Fallback behavior: smart-routing supports per-route auto-fallback to pinned-compatible variants. Default canary policy: canary_auto_fallback=true with a 10% immunity window to avoid flip-flopping. Manual opt-out available for debugging.

Marta: Concrete action items I captured: Nadia -> docs PR, Ben -> canary dashboard & eval run, Priya -> reservation schedule, Liam -> finalize alerts + runbook link, Aisha -> runtime flags + SDK helpers. I'll open a GH issue to track.

deploy-bot: Canary started for runtime-kernel-v5 canary_id=ck-1749999999-01 (2% traffic).

Ben: Running eval harness against the canary with real split traffic now. Command will be posted in #eng-ml.

Nadia: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime-docs/pull/501 added with KV TTL guide and examples. Feedback welcome.

Priya: Reservation sheet posted: https://internal.redwood/schedules/dedicated-v5-reserve (reserving 03/26 00:00-06:00 UTC for burst checks).

Sam: Thanks team. Please add PR/issue links in this thread as you create them and react with :white_check_mark: when you take an item. If blockers pop up, call them out here. Closing for new action items but updates welcome in-thread.
